Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS (observed): WASD moves; arrows fire/aim/set facing; movement+fire combine; tears auto-fire in facing direction. E places bombs (left-click does NOT). Space activates active item (no visible effect observed with Match Stick or Tech X). Q use/drop card (no confirmed effect). Fine movement: 0.1s≈40px, 0.2s≈80px, 0.3s≈120px, 0.5s≈200px. Inputs sometimes drop for a step; retry instead of assuming a wall, and test single-axis components when a diagonal stalls. Door/hatch/trapdoor/alcove transitions need centered overlap PLUS 2-3 repeated presses; standing inside the alcove and pressing again helps; a single press almost never works. If presses fail repeatedly, step out and re-enter, or nudge 0.1s to re-center. Player sprite renders inconsistently (white/pink blob, TV-head, gray-faced, frowning face) and can resemble enemies—confirm identity by moving. In the dark stone room, Tech X rings sometimes burst without obvious input; Tech X also auto-bursts periodically in the rock room (confirmed observed).

HUD/PICKUPS (observed): hearts go hollow after damage; blue/soul hearts from blue pill; counters for coins, keys, bombs; item/card slots; top-right icon stack lists collected items. All-hollow hearts observed repeatedly; once preceded a run end, but twice the room stayed interactive and controllable—treat as critical/ambiguous. Pickups on touch, but coins/small items need exact overlap and sometimes register a step late (Match Stick banner appeared after delay). Silent non-collecting floor objects exist (cup-like object beside TNT-room upper crate, floor matchstick, gray outlined tile—all inert scenery). Poop sometimes hides/releases items; several poops inert. Crates may damage on contact; some vanish or act mimic-like. Pickup pedestals can re-grant TECH X (occurred in the two-poop chamber, surprising).

TECH X (observed): radial ring tear with red X impact; radius ~140-150px; blocks line of fire; point-blank unsafe. Damages fats, gray faces, shelled enemies, flies, clustered spiders. Does NOT crack rock rings, TNT barrels, gray crates, or rock clusters; embedded eye-faces survived blasts (likely invulnerable). y-offset >~70px misses. Item banners (TECH X; MATCH STICK—'Tastes like burning'; 2 OF SPADES—'Item multiplier') can replace the active item; after Match Stick, ring bursts were not visibly firing (unconfirmed). Space with Match Stick produced no fire or effect in two rooms.

ENEMIES: winged flies are tanky, chase/fire tears downward, and often guard hatches. Fat pink/white/gray-faced enemies are very tanky, enrage with red aura/tint, chase relentlessly, contact drains hearts fast (killed a 1-heart run in the boss room), die in red splatter. Shelled white-faced enemies emerge from spiky rock piles, fire blue/green orbs, retreat into rock form (immune while shelled), and leave damaging green spiky clouds that persist and can finish a 1-HP player—never linger near them. Bomb-bugs are burst-immune, idle until approached, and can detonate TNT as a chain with delayed secondary explosions (a chain fired seconds after the initial blast, costing a heart)—clear the area for several seconds after any blast. Black spiders cluster and are deadly at close range. Green spiky clouds, poison puddles, brazier flames, orbs, and falling sack tears damage. Gilded sack with a fly in the boss room fires teardrops.

NAVIGATION (observed): Tutorial room ('BASEMENT I', MOVE/ATTACK/BOMB/ITEM wall paintings): top hatch ↔ rock/shop room; bottom trapdoor ↔ brazier room; right-wall dark riveted door ↔ dark stone room. Rock/shop room: left gold-framed keyhole door never opened with 0 keys; shop once sold bomb 5¢, card 15¢; right rock cluster is unbreakable by tears/Tech X (a cup-like object beside it is inert scenery); top hatch ↔ TNT room (transition works after clearing enemies + centered alcove + repeats); bottom hatch ↔ tutorial. TNT room: two isolated TNT barrels mid-room flank a safe central gap; left wall has TNT cluster, gray crates (inert to bombs and tears; survived a full chain), a reddish barrel; a bomb-bug idles on the left/upper-right; top hatch ↔ boss room; bottom trapdoor ↔ rock room. Boss room: central rock pile blocks fire lanes; dark left-wall statue with red glow/eyes undamaged by attacks; embedded eye-faces in right rock wall; gilded sack with a fly at right that shoots teardrops; card on floor; bottom trapdoor ↔ TNT room; no other exit observed. Brazier room: four damaging corner braziers; central chest inside a solid rock ring—bombs and TECH X failed, and the chest proved inert to contact and to tears even after entry (likely decorative stone crate); poop left of ring is inert; bottom-center golden gate ↔ two-poop chamber; top-center alcove ↔ tutorial room; left corridor bypasses the ring. Two-poop chamber: two poops flank a central rock; recurring faint gray outlined floor tile never opens (likely shadow/crawlspace marker needing a bomb—untested at 0 bombs); a yellow key-like sliver appeared and vanished without raising the key counter; item here was another TECH X pedestal; top golden gate ↔ brazier room; otherwise a dead end. Dark stone room: left exit ↔ tutorial; two red-barred chests top wall (open/close uncertainty); central red spiked chest inside a damaging white spike cross; two floor holes (probably pits); black spiders spawn inside. Extremely punishing—retreat at low HP.

RING CHEST ENTRY (observed, new): the brazier-room rock ring CAN be entered by slipping through the left-lower diagonal gap near x≈550, y≈365 (approach from the poop side, small 0.2-0.3s diagonal w/d steps through the widest opening between the upper-left rock and lower rocks). Bottom-center notch and right-side seams were blocked. Chest inside is inert regardless.
